# 01-upgrade-dotnet-11: Upgrade runtime and SDK selection and review C# modernizations

Verify the installed RC3 toolchain and upgrade ContributorAvatars from net10.0 to net11.0. Configure SDK and framework-dependent runtime selection to use RC3 now and prefer installed .NET 11 GA later without selecting .NET 12. Preserve the existing package versions and 3500-byte avatar threshold. The assessment flags one potential HttpContent behavioral change at the image download; validate byte-array reads rather than changing APIs speculatively.

Review Program.cs against C# 13 through 15 features and older opportunities left in the original .NET 8 code. Record useful recommendations and reasons not to introduce features that do not fit; do not perform unrelated source refactors. Update README prerequisites, dependency documentation, and roll-forward behavior.

## Research Findings

- ContributorAvatars.csproj defines net10.0 directly; dependency inspection found no local MSBuild imports. Installed SDK is 11.0.100-rc.3.26522.148 and runtime is 11.0.0-rc.3.26522.148. No global.json or .editorconfig exists at the repository root.
- Preserve Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU 15.0.0 and Spectre.Console 0.57.2; assessment reports all four direct/transitive packages compatible, no package changes required. Mandatory issue Project.0002 is the framework change; potential Api.0003 is HttpContent.ReadAsByteArrayAsync at Program.cs:33. There are no stubs, project dependencies, or Test Explorer tests.
- Add global.json with the installed RC3 SDK minimum, latestFeature and allowPrerelease=true. Set net11.0, RuntimeFrameworkVersion to the RC3 minimum, and RollForward=LatestMinor in the project. This prefers the highest available .NET 11 runtime, including GA when RC3 remains installed. It does not install updates and applies only to framework-dependent launches. C# 15 is the net11.0 default; no preview language flag is needed.
- Review only: C# 15 collection arguments have no current constructor-argument use case; union types, closed hierarchies, extension indexers, labeled jumps, and static interface compatibility offer no simplification to this top-level program. Earlier opportunities include empty collection expressions, range slicing, null patterns, and static local helpers. Keep default HashSet comparison unchanged; adding OrdinalIgnoreCase would change behavior and requires a separate decision.
- Isolated validation will check generated configuration, RC-only launch, simulated RC+GA and .NET 12-only host layouts, SDK selection, HttpContent bytes at the 3500-byte boundary, and cached-image montage in a disposable fixture. Simulated GA paths reuse installed RC binaries to exercise host selection only, not GA compatibility.
- Build tool: native IDE build, with dotnet CLI for captured diagnostics and host-resolution checks. No existing test suite was found; do not create a persistent test project just for upgrade verification.
- No decomposition hints apply: scope is one small project with known changes and compatible packages. Configuration and its validation form one atomic upgrade.
- A clean CLI rebuild exposed three existing nullable warnings in JSON parsing. Explicitly reject null release/contributor entries with JsonException; valid data behavior is unchanged. Add valid/malformed JSON checks to isolated validation.

**Done when**: SDK resolution selects the installed RC3; the project targets net11.0 / C# 15; generated runtime configuration has the RC3 minimum and within-.NET-11 roll-forward; isolated resolution checks prefer a simulated GA candidate over RC3 and reject .NET 12-only candidates; the solution builds with zero warnings and errors; isolated smoke checks pass for HttpContent bytes, avatar boundaries, valid/malformed JSON, and cached-image montage; review and runtime caveats are documented; unrelated behavior and local changes are preserved.
